scope: bounded Android/Termux Herdr client transport attachment

repositoryStructure.purpose: source binding, workflow, probes, registries and reports for the client-attach gate
parent Herdr migration/server harness and prior live gates

knownTraps: Bare `herdr` is not an attach-only primitive: auto-detect may spawn a detached server if the client socket disappears.
`terminal session observe` proves the TerminalAttach client protocol path, not the full Herdr app TUI.
A terminal frame may contain operator data; evidence must record metadata only and never persist frame bytes.
Server stop ends sandbox pane processes; this gate is ephemeral and does not test persistence.
The Linux-musl binary executing on Android does not become an upstream-supported Android build.

buildTestDeploy.deploy: none; no Herdr installation is authorized
